name: v1
description: Whole-app perf scenario: cold-start → load multi-take session → scrub timeline × 3 cycles → camera-layout switch → line annotation → frame-by-frame scrub → data-box toggle → controlled shutdown.

warmupSteps.comment: Wait for MC_READY sentinel on stdout (W1.1). 120s budget covers cold-start GPU init + HLSL JIT.
Let WPF dispatcher drain after MC_READY: theme load, splash close, hardware calibration tasks.

warmupSteps.name: warmup-detect-screen
warmupSteps.comment: Confirm we are on Home (HomeViewControl sentinel). Expected: Home.

warmupSteps.name: warmup-to-user-selection
warmupSteps.comment: Navigate Home → UserSelection. mc_navigate_to clicks AnalyzeButton automatically via screens.yml edge.
Wait for UserSelection screen to settle (student list populated from seeded DB).

warmupSteps.name: warmup-select-student
warmupSteps.comment: Select seeded student 'Perf Test User' (StudentID=100, seed.sql). automationId verified: SelectStudentOrGroupControl.xaml:164. itemText must match the display name from the DB.
Let student details panel populate after selection.

warmupSteps.name: warmup-click-next
warmupSteps.comment: Click Next → Analysis. automationId verified: SelectStudentOrGroupControl.xaml:365.
Wait for Analysis view to fully load: video decode, frame cache build, layout quiescence. 60s for cold-start GPU spike (VideoEffectsRendererGpu lazy-init + HLSL JIT).

warmupSteps.name: warmup-confirm-analysis
warmupSteps.comment: Confirm we reached the Analysis screen (VideoPlaybackControl sentinel per screens.yml).

warmupSteps.name: warmup-scrub-midpoint
warmupSteps.comment: Warmup scrub to midpoint. Forces GPU texture upload + first full render pipeline activation. automationId verified: BookmarkControl.xaml:23 (x:Name=VideoSlider). Value is normalized [0..1]; 0.5 = midpoint of take.
Wait for render pipeline to settle after warmup scrub.

warmupSteps.name: warmup-scrub-return
warmupSteps.comment: Return to frame 0 to start measured run from a consistent position.
Settle at frame 0 before ETW capture begins.

steps.label: v1
steps.comment: ETW bracket open. MotionCatalyst-PerfHarness EventSource (W1.3).

steps.name: step-detect-screen
steps.comment: Sanity check: confirm we are still on Analysis before measured work begins.

steps.label: open-session
steps.comment: Phase: open seeded session. Session is already open from warmup; this event brackets the 'settled analysis view' baseline.

steps.name: settle-analysis-open
steps.comment: Confirm layout is quiesced after warmup sequence. First measured idle sample.

steps.name: scrub-fwd-1
steps.comment: Scrub forward ~5 s equivalent (33% of take = roughly 5 s for a 15 s take). VideoSlider is normalized [0..1]. automationId: BookmarkControl.xaml:23.
Wait for frame decode + WPF render after slider move.

steps.name: scrub-back-1
steps.comment: Scrub back to start.
Settle at frame 0.

steps.name: scrub-fwd-2
steps.comment: Scrub forward to 66% (further into take for variety).
Settle after scrub.

steps.name: scrub-fwd-3
steps.comment: Scrub all the way to the last frame.

args.comment: TODO_FIND_ACTUAL_ID: LayoutHighlight is the HighlightFeature wrapper in AnalysisMenu.xaml:1778. The actual DropDownButton inside does not have its own x:Name. Try clicking LayoutHighlight first; if that fails, use wpf_find_elements to discover the inner DropDownButton automationId. Verified context: AnalysisMenu.xaml lines 1772-1921.

steps.name: open-layout-dropdown
steps.comment: Open the Layout/Camera dropdown in the View toolbar. This reveals the camera-count ListBox.
Wait for dropdown popup to open and populate.

args.comment: TODO_FIND_ACTUAL_ID: The camera ListBox inside the LayoutHighlight dropdown (AngleModes / AnalysisViewModes) has no x:Name in AnalysisMenu.xaml. Use wpf_find_elements with typeName=ListBox after opening the dropdown to discover the automationId at runtime during PoC spike.

steps.name: select-2-camera-layout
steps.comment: Switch to 2-camera layout (index 1). Drives MultiView.SelectedScreenLayout change → layout invalidation → WPF re-render. This is a significant layout-pass workload.
Wait for MultiView to re-render with new layout. LayoutUpdated quiescence required.

steps.name: activate-line-tool
steps.comment: Activate the Line drawing tool. automationId verified: ToolsGroupBoxControl.xaml:444. This sets DrawingTools.SelectedTool = Line.
Let tool activation state propagate (CanvasOverlay mode change).

args.comment: TODO_FIND_ACTUAL_ID: Drawing a line annotation requires mouse-down + mouse-up on the video canvas (VideoPresenterWPF). wpf_send_keys cannot place a line. The correct approach is wpf_click on the VideoViewA element at position (0.3, 0.4) for start point, then wpf_click at (0.7, 0.6) for end point. wpf_click with relative coordinates may not be supported — check wpf_click parameter list during PoC spike. Fallback: use wpf_execute_command with DrawingTools.DrawLineCommand if that command exists.

steps.name: draw-line-placeholder
steps.comment: PLACEHOLDER: line drawing requires coordinate-based clicks on the video viewport. See comment in args. This step will be replaced after PoC spike confirms the coordinate-click API.
Wait for annotation canvas overlay to re-render after line placement.

steps.name: deactivate-line-tool
steps.comment: Return to Select tool (deactivates drawing mode). automationId verified: ToolsGroupBoxControl.xaml:296.

steps.name: position-for-framestep
steps.comment: Move to 10% into the take before frame-stepping, so we have room to step forward.

steps.name: step-frame-fwd-1
steps.comment: Step forward 1 frame. automationId verified: VideoPlaybackControl.xaml:196 (x:Name=StepForwardButton, Command=Playback.StepForwardCommand).

steps.name: step-frame-back-1
steps.comment: Step backward. automationId verified: VideoPlaybackControl.xaml:189 (x:Name=StepBackwardButton, Command=Playback.StepBackwardCommand).

steps.name: hide-data-boxes
steps.comment: Toggle HideDataboxes=true (collapse the data panel). automationId verified: MultiView.xaml:1347 (x:Name=HideBoxSingleSwing, IsChecked binds to HideDataboxes). This triggers a layout pass on the MultiView grid.
Wait for layout re-measure after data box collapse.

steps.name: show-data-boxes
steps.comment: Restore data boxes (HideDataboxes=false). Second layout pass.
Wait for layout to re-expand.

steps.name: final-settle
steps.comment: Final dispatcher drain before scenario-end event.

steps.label: v1
steps.comment: ETW bracket close. MotionCatalyst-PerfHarness EventSource (W1.3).
mc_disconnect(closeTarget=true). Runner issues WM_CLOSE and waits up to 30s for clean exit.
